# Compatibility & browser support

The project targets **React 19.3** (`react@^19.3.1`) and **Node.js 22.12+**. Every topic
records the minimum React version of the APIs it uses, so you can tell what works
on older React versions.

## Browser-dependent and client-only topics

| Topic                                                                                               | Support         | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [useEffect — event listeners, timers & browser APIs](built-in-hooks/use-effect-subscriptions.md)    | client-only     | Effects only run in the browser.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [useEffect — WebSocket connection](built-in-hooks/use-effect-websocket.md)                          | client-only     | The socket is served by MSW in the browser and in tests (`LIVE_SOCKET_URL`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [useEffect — race conditions & AbortController](built-in-hooks/use-effect-race-conditions.md)       | client-only     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [useLayoutEffect — measure before paint](built-in-hooks/use-layout-effect.md)                       | client-only     | Layout effects do not run on the server; use an isomorphic wrapper or render the measured UI client-side only.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [useInsertionEffect — CSS-in-JS style injection](built-in-hooks/use-insertion-effect.md)            | client-only     | Does not run on the server; real libraries collect styles during SSR separately.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [useRef — canvas drawing](built-in-hooks/use-ref-canvas.md)                                         | browser-limited | Falls back to a message when `getContext("2d")` returns null.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [useRef — integrating imperative third-party widgets](built-in-hooks/use-ref-imperative-widgets.md) | client-only     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [<ViewTransition> & addTransitionType](built-in-hooks/view-transition.md)                           | browser-limited | Needs `document.startViewTransition`; elsewhere React applies the update without animation. DOM only (not React Native).                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [Fragment refs](built-in-hooks/fragment-refs.md)                                                    | client-only     | The ref is attached on the client; FragmentInstance methods are DOM-only.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [useAnimationFrame](custom-hooks/use-animation-frame.md)                                            | client-only     | No-op on the server and without `requestAnimationFrame`; browsers pause rAF in background tabs.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [useIdle](custom-hooks/use-idle.md)                                                                 | client-only     | Returns `initialState` on the server; listeners attach after hydration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [useEventListener](custom-hooks/use-event-listener.md)                                              | client-only     | No-op on the server; listeners attach after hydration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [useClickOutside](custom-hooks/use-click-outside.md)                                                | client-only     | Pointer Events everywhere modern; falls back to `mousedown` + `touchstart` without `PointerEvent`. No-op on the server.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [useHover](custom-hooks/use-hover.md)                                                               | client-only     | `false` on the server and on devices without hover.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [useFocus](custom-hooks/use-focus.md)                                                               | client-only     | `false` on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [useFocusWithin](custom-hooks/use-focus-within.md)                                                  | client-only     | `false` on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [useIntersectionObserver](custom-hooks/use-intersection-observer.md)                                | browser-limited | Supported in all current browsers (Safari since 12.1). Missing in old browsers and jsdom: `isSupported` is `false` and `initialIsIntersecting` is reported.                                                                                                                                 |
| [useResizeObserver](custom-hooks/use-resize-observer.md)                                            | browser-limited | All current browsers; `box: "device-pixel-content-box"` is not supported in Safari. Missing in jsdom → `isSupported: false`.                                                                                                                                                                |
| [useElementSize](custom-hooks/use-element-size.md)                                                  | browser-limited | Uses `contentBoxSize`/`borderBoxSize`, falling back to `contentRect`/`offsetWidth` on Safari < 15.4. Without ResizeObserver `initialSize` is returned.                                                                                                                                      |
| [useScrollPosition](custom-hooks/use-scroll-position.md)                                            | client-only     | `{ x: 0, y: 0 }` on the server and until the first frame.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [useScrollLock](custom-hooks/use-scroll-lock.md)                                                    | client-only     | iOS Safari before 16 ignores `overflow: hidden` on `body` for touch scrolling. No-op on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [useFullscreen](custom-hooks/use-fullscreen.md)                                                     | browser-limited | Unprefixed in Chromium, Firefox and Safari 16.4+; older Safari uses the `webkit` prefix (handled). iPhone Safari only supports full screen for `<video>` (via `webkitEnterFullscreen`), so `isSupported` is `false` there. Iframes need `allow="fullscreen"`.                               |
| [useDocumentTitle](custom-hooks/use-document-title.md)                                              | client-only     | Nothing happens on the server (effects do not run).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [useClipboard](custom-hooks/use-clipboard.md)                                                       | browser-limited | Requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost). `writeText` works from user gestures in all modern browsers (Safari/Firefox require transient user activation). `readText` prompts: Chromium asks for the `clipboard-read` permission; Safari and Firefox (125+) show a Paste confirmation. |
| [useGeolocation](custom-hooks/use-geolocation.md)                                                   | browser-limited | Available in all modern browsers but only in secure contexts; insecure origins and Permissions Policy report `permission-denied`. Desktop accuracy is often Wi-Fi/IP based.                                                                                                                 |
| [useNetworkInformation](custom-hooks/use-network-information.md)                                    | browser-limited | Chromium-based browsers only (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet). Not implemented in Firefox or Safari: `isSupported` is `false` and all fields are `undefined`. `type` is only exposed on Android/ChromeOS.                                                                            |
| [useLocalStorage](custom-hooks/use-local-storage.md)                                                | client-only     | Renders `initialValue` on the server. Falls back to in-memory storage when Web Storage is blocked.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [useSessionStorage](custom-hooks/use-session-storage.md)                                            | client-only     | Renders `initialValue` on the server; in-memory fallback when storage is blocked.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| [useCookie](custom-hooks/use-cookie.md)                                                             | client-only     | Renders `serverValue` on the server. Uses the Cookie Store API `change` event where available; otherwise re-reads when the tab becomes visible.                                                                                                                                             |
| [usePersistentState](custom-hooks/use-persistent-state.md)                                          | client-only     | Renders `initialValue` on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [useBroadcastChannel](custom-hooks/use-broadcast-channel.md)                                        | browser-limited | Feature-detected (`isSupported`); `false` on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [useCrossTabState](custom-hooks/use-cross-tab-state.md)                                             | browser-limited | Behaves like plain `useState` without BroadcastChannel and on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [useInfiniteScroll](custom-hooks/use-infinite-scroll.md)                                            | browser-limited | `isSupported` is `false` without IntersectionObserver and on the server — render a “Load more” button.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [usePolling](custom-hooks/use-polling.md)                                                           | client-only     | Idle on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [useWebSocket](custom-hooks/use-web-socket.md)                                                      | client-only     | `closed` and `isSupported: false` on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [useSSE](custom-hooks/use-sse.md)                                                                   | browser-limited | Feature-detects `EventSource` (`isSupported`). The mock `/api/events` exists only in browsers.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [useFocusTrap](custom-hooks/use-focus-trap.md)                                                      | client-only     | Uses `Element.checkVisibility()` when available to skip hidden elements; falls back to `hidden`/`inert` attribute checks.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [useKeyboardShortcut](custom-hooks/use-keyboard-shortcut.md)                                        | client-only     | Listens after hydration; `isApplePlatform()` is `false` on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [useEscapeKey](custom-hooks/use-escape-key.md)                                                      | client-only     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [useAnnouncer](custom-hooks/use-announcer.md)                                                       | client-only     | Regions are created after mount; nothing is rendered on the server.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [useDialogState](custom-hooks/use-dialog-state.md)                                                  | client-only     | `showModal()` is supported by all evergreen browsers; without it the dialog opens non-modally via the `open` attribute.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [useOrientation](custom-hooks/use-orientation.md)                                                   | browser-limited | `screen.orientation` is in every current engine (Safari since 16.4). Older browsers use the `(orientation: portrait)` media query, which has no angle. Server: `source: "none"`.                                                                                                            |
| [useVibration](custom-hooks/use-vibration.md)                                                       | browser-limited | Chromium-based browsers on Android. Safari (iOS/macOS) never supported it, so `isSupported` is `false` there. Desktop hardware usually has no motor.                                                                                                                                        |
| [useBattery](custom-hooks/use-battery.md)                                                           | browser-limited | Chromium-based browsers in secure contexts only. Firefox removed the API over fingerprinting concerns; Safari never shipped it. Can be blocked by the `battery` Permissions-Policy.                                                                                                         |
| [usePointerPosition](custom-hooks/use-pointer-position.md)                                          | client-only     | Returns `null` on the server and until the first move.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [useSpeechRecognition](custom-hooks/use-speech-recognition.md)                                      | browser-limited | Chromium-based browsers and Safari (prefixed `webkitSpeechRecognition`); not Firefox. Needs a secure context and microphone permission.                                                                                                                                                     |
| [useSpeechSynthesis](custom-hooks/use-speech-synthesis.md)                                          | browser-limited | Available in all modern browsers; voices depend on the OS. Chromium only speaks after a user gesture.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [usePermission](custom-hooks/use-permission.md)                                                     | browser-limited | The API exists in all modern browsers, but supported permission names differ (Chromium accepts the most). Unknown names reject with a `TypeError` → `status: "error"`.                                                                                                                      |
| [useWebWorker](custom-hooks/use-web-worker.md)                                                      | client-only     | Workers exist in every modern browser; `isSupported` is `false` on the server and in jsdom.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| [usePerformanceMeasure](custom-hooks/use-performance-measure.md)                                    | browser-limited | User Timing exists everywhere modern; `detail` needs User Timing Level 3 (falls back without it). Without `PerformanceObserver` entries are read back directly.                                                                                                                             |
| [Zustand](state-management/zustand.md)                                                              | client-only     | The `persist` middleware reads localStorage when the store is created; for SSR use `skipHydration` and rehydrate on the client.                                                                                                                                                             |
| [Infinite scroll with a “Load more” fallback](scenarios/infinite-scroll-feed.md)                    | browser-limited | Without IntersectionObserver pages load only through the “Load more” button.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [Theme switching (light / dark / system)](scenarios/theme-switching.md)                             | client-only     | Without `matchMedia` (server, very old browsers) the OS preference is unknown and “System” uses light.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [Live notifications over WebSocket](scenarios/live-notifications.md)                                | browser-limited | Shows a notice and stays disconnected where `WebSocket` is unavailable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [Toast notifications](scenarios/toast-notifications.md)                                             | client-only     | `useEffectEvent` (React 19.2) keeps the expiry callback fresh inside the timer effect.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [Copy to clipboard with feedback and fallback](scenarios/clipboard-copy-paste.md)                   | browser-limited | The async Clipboard API exists only in secure contexts (HTTPS, localhost). Reading needs the `clipboard-read` permission in Chromium and a paste confirmation in Safari/Firefox.                                                                                                            |
| [ESP trading desk: ticket, blotter and positions](scenarios/esp-trading-blotter.md)                 | client-only     | esp-js 8 references `self` when imported, so it cannot be imported during Node SSR without a shim.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [Offline banner and persisted action queue](scenarios/offline-action-queue.md)                      | browser-limited | `navigator.onLine` is universal; the Network Information API is Chromium-only and shown as unsupported elsewhere.                                                                                                                                                                           |
